rust_summary: the current of a fluid at a position (`native_fluid_flow`, `FluidState.getFlow`).
doc_summary: `native_fluid_flow(pos)` is `FluidState.getFlow(level, pos)` in the level in place: the normalised current an item in the fluid is pushed by, zero for still or no fluid. Bundles need "hooks": @API:fluid_flow@.
